call_points.text: EV timelines have been pushed back by 3 to 5 years due to slower-than-expected adoption.
Fasteners business capex for FY27 is pegged at approximately ₹75 crores for capacity expansion and operational enhancements.
Management expects to maintain steady-state EBITDA margins around 15% plus for the fastener business.
Q1FY27 will be a pressure quarter as costs and customer price increases are adjusted.
The company secured approximately ₹64 crores of business acquisitions during FY26.
The stand-alone fastener business remains net debt free and generated ₹83.3 crores of operating cash flow in FY26.
OBC and DC/DC production lines are expected to be commissioned by end of Q2 FY27, with supplies from Q3 FY27.
STML expects commercial production for serial orders from July/August 2026 onwards.
SEM will not be profitable in FY27, with a return to profit expected in FY28.
The company estimates a 25% to 30% market share in the domestic automotive fastener segment.

operating_notes.text: Signed technical collaboration and supply agreement with Nanjing Haohang Technology Co. Ltd., China, to localize ARAS for the Indian two-wheeler market.
Sterling Tools partnered with Nanjing Haohang to localize Advanced Rider Assistance Systems (ARAS) for the Indian two-wheeler market.
EV adoption across segments has progressed slower than expected, shifting timelines by nearly 3 to 5 years.
Current fastener capacities can support revenue of about ₹800 crores plus, with the FY27 capex building capability up to ₹900-1,000 crores.
The Indian HVDC contactors and pre-charge relays market is estimated at approximately ₹300 crores, expected to grow to over ₹750 crores by the end of the decade.
Enhanced FY27 capex plan to approximately ₹135 crore across businesses.
